description: Dynamic Island-style Windows overlay with media controls, notifications, focus timers, system monitoring, volume mixer, and notes.
notes: Verified with 7-Zip 26.05: the official NSIS package extracts pillar.exe at the payload root (8 files were inspected). Scoop uses #/dl.7z and does not execute the vendor setup routine.
The release also provides an MSI, but the NSIS extraction succeeded, so this manifest uses the verified NSIS payload. The MSI fallback was not needed.
The optional Prism AI assistant requires the GROQ_API_KEY environment variable; the other application features do not require this key.
